connection.title: Connection
connection.description: How Screeny reaches the device: USB, TCP/IP or a specific serial. With a single device connected you don't need to set anything.

video.title: Video
video.description: Video stream encoding and quality: codec, bit rate, maximum resolution, frame rate and orientation.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Forwarding the device audio to the PC (Android 11+): source, codec, bit rate and buffering.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Mirror the camera instead of the screen. Requires Android 12+ and the video source set to camera.

display.title: Display
display.description: Which display to show, or a separate virtual display to start an app on.

input.title: Input & control
input.description: How the PC keyboard, mouse and gamepads control the device, and clipboard handling.

window.title: Window
window.description: Look and position of the scrcpy window on the PC.

device.title: Device behavior
device.description: What happens on the device during and after the session: screen, standby, touches.

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: Record the session to a video or audio file.

network.title: Network & adb tunnel
network.description: Ports and adb tunnel. Change them only for unusual network setups.

log.title: Log & diagnostics
log.description: Level of detail of the scrcpy messages shown in the log.

serial.label: Device serial
serial.description: Serial of the device. Required only when several devices are connected to adb (list them with 'adb devices -l').

select-usb.label: Use USB device
select-usb.description: Use the USB device, if there is exactly one (like 'adb -d').

select-tcpip.label: Use TCP/IP device
select-tcpip.description: Use the TCP/IP device, if there is exactly one (like 'adb -e').

tcpip.label: TCP/IP connection
tcpip.description: Configure and connect the device over TCP/IP. With an address it connects to it (default port 5555). Without an address it finds the IP of the device connected over USB, enables TCP/IP and connects. The '+' prefix forces a reconnection.

kill-adb-on-close.label: Kill adb on close
kill-adb-on-close.description: Terminate the adb process when scrcpy closes.

video-source.label: Video source
video-source.description: Source of the video. Camera requires Android 12+.

video-codec.label: Video codec
video-codec.description: Codec used to encode the video on the device.

video-bit-rate.label: Video bit rate
video-bit-rate.description: Video encoding bit rate in bits/s. Suffixes allowed: K (x1000) and M (x1000000).

max-size.label: Maximum size
max-size.description: Limit both width and height of the video; the other dimension keeps the aspect ratio. In camera mode it selects the source size. 0 = unlimited.

max-fps.label: Maximum FPS
max-fps.description: Limit the capture frame rate (officially supported since Android 10).

video-buffer.label: Video buffer (ms)
video-buffer.description: Buffering delay before frames are displayed. Adds latency to smooth out jitter. 0 = no buffering.

video-encoder.label: Video encoder
video-encoder.description: Specific MediaCodec encoder to use (depends on the selected video codec).

video-codec-options.label: Video codec options
video-codec-options.description: Comma-separated options for the device video encoder. type: int (default), long, float, string. Keys: https://d.android.com/reference/android/media/MediaFormat

crop.label: Crop
crop.description: Crop the screen on the device side. Values are in the natural device orientation (portrait for a phone, landscape for a tablet).

angle.label: Custom rotation (degrees)
angle.description: Rotate the video content by an arbitrary angle, in degrees, clockwise.

capture-orientation.label: Capture orientation
capture-orientation.description: Orientation of the captured video: clockwise rotation in degrees; 'flip' applies a horizontal flip before rotating. The '@' prefix locks the rotation relative to the natural orientation; '@' alone locks it to the initial orientation.

values.@0: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@90: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@180: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@270: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@flip0: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@flip90: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@flip180: Locked, relative to the natural orientation
values.@flip270: Locked, relative to the natural orientation

display-orientation.label: Display orientation
display-orientation.description: Initial orientation of the picture on the PC: clockwise rotation in degrees; 'flip' applies a horizontal flip before rotating.

min-size-alignment.label: Minimum size alignment
min-size-alignment.description: Video width and height will be multiples of this value (the larger of this and what the codec requires).

ignore-video-encoder-constraints.label: Ignore encoder constraints
ignore-video-encoder-constraints.description: Do not consider the capabilities reported by the video encoder (useful when they are wrong). Forcing a minimum alignment may also help.

no-downsize-on-error.label: Don't downsize on error
no-downsize-on-error.description: By default, on a MediaCodec error scrcpy retries with a lower resolution. This option disables that.

no-video-playback.label: Don't show the video
no-video-playback.description: Disable video playback on the PC (the video is still captured, e.g. for recording).

hwdec.label: Hardware decoding
hwdec.description: Hardware video decoding on the PC.

values.auto: First available hardware decoder, otherwise software

audio-source.label: Audio source
audio-source.description: Source of the audio captured on the device.

values.output: Whole audio output; disables playback on the device

audio-codec.label: Audio codec
audio-codec.description: Codec used to encode the audio on the device.

audio-bit-rate.label: Audio bit rate
audio-bit-rate.description: Audio encoding bit rate in bits/s. Suffixes allowed: K (x1000) and M (x1000000). Ignored for flac and raw.

audio-buffer.label: Audio buffer (ms)
audio-buffer.description: Audio buffering delay. Lower values reduce latency but increase the risk of glitches.

audio-output-buffer.label: SDL output buffer (ms)
audio-output-buffer.description: Size of the SDL audio output buffer. Don't change it without a good reason.

audio-encoder.label: Audio encoder
audio-encoder.description: Specific MediaCodec encoder to use (depends on the selected audio codec).

audio-codec-options.label: Audio codec options
audio-codec-options.description: Comma-separated options for the device audio encoder. type: int (default), long, float, string. Keys: https://d.android.com/reference/android/media/MediaFormat

audio-dup.label: Duplicate audio
audio-dup.description: Capture the audio and keep playing it on the device too.

no-audio-playback.label: Don't play the audio
no-audio-playback.description: Disable audio playback on the PC.

require-audio.label: Require audio
require-audio.description: By default, if audio capture fails scrcpy goes on with video only. With this option it fails instead.

camera-id.label: Camera id
camera-id.description: Id of the camera to show.

camera-facing.label: Camera facing
camera-facing.description: Select the camera by its facing direction.

camera-ar.label: Camera aspect ratio
camera-ar.description: Select the camera size by aspect ratio (+/- 10%): 'sensor' (the sensor's own), '<num>:<den>' (e.g. 4:3) or a value (e.g. 1.6).

camera-fps.label: Camera FPS
camera-fps.description: Camera capture frame rate. When not set, Android's default (30 fps) is used.

camera-high-speed.label: High-speed mode
camera-high-speed.description: Enable high-speed capture. Limited to specific resolutions and frame rates (see --list-camera-sizes).

camera-torch.label: Turn on torch
camera-torch.description: Turn on the camera flash when the camera starts.

new-display.label: New virtual display
new-display.description: Create a new virtual display with the given resolution and density. Without a value it uses the main display size and DPI. Examples: 1920x1080, 1920x1080/420, /240.

flex-display.label: Flexible display
flex-display.description: Continuously resize the virtual display to match the window.

display-ime-policy.label: On-screen keyboard placement
display-ime-policy.description: Where to show the on-screen keyboard (IME). Only on a secondary display (display id other than 0 or a new display).

no-vd-destroy-content.label: Keep apps on close
no-vd-destroy-content.description: When the virtual display closes, running apps are moved to the main display instead of being destroyed.

no-vd-system-decorations.label: No system decorations
no-vd-system-decorations.description: Disable system decorations on the virtual display.

start-app.label: Start app
start-app.description: Start an Android app by package name. Prefix '?' = search by name (case-insensitive, slower); '+' = force-stop before starting; both in the order '+?'.

keyboard.label: Keyboard mode
keyboard.description: How to send the keyboard to the device. With uhid and aoa the layout must be configured on the device (Settings > System > Languages & input > Physical keyboard). On Windows, aoa only works in OTG mode.

mouse.label: Mouse mode
mouse.description: How to send the mouse to the device. In uhid and aoa the mouse is captured (LAlt, LSuper or RSuper release it). On Windows, aoa only works in OTG mode.

gamepad.label: Gamepad mode
gamepad.description: How to send gamepads to the device.

mouse-bind.label: Secondary click bindings
mouse-bind.description: One or two sequences of 4 characters (right, middle, 4th, 5th click); the second applies while Shift is held. Characters: '+' forward, '-' ignore, 'b' BACK, 'h' HOME, 's' APP_SWITCH, 'n' notification panel. Default 'bhsn:++++' (sdk) or '++++:bhsn' (uhid/aoa).

no-mouse-hover.label: Don't forward hover
no-mouse-hover.description: Don't forward mouse motion without clicks.

prefer-text.label: Prefer text events
prefer-text.description: Inject letters and space as text events instead of key events. Avoids issues with special characters but breaks keys in games (WASD).

raw-key-events.label: Key events only
raw-key-events.description: Inject key events for all keys and ignore text events.

no-key-repeat.label: No key repeat
no-key-repeat.description: Don't forward repeated key events while a key is held down.

legacy-paste.label: Legacy paste
legacy-paste.description: On Ctrl+V inject the clipboard text as a sequence of key events. Workaround for devices that don't accept a clipboard set through the API.

no-clipboard-autosync.label: No clipboard sync
no-clipboard-autosync.description: Disable automatic clipboard synchronization between PC and device.

shortcut-mod.label: Shortcut modifiers
shortcut-mod.description: Modifier keys for scrcpy shortcuts; each selected key enables the shortcuts on its own.

otg.label: OTG mode
otg.description: Simulate a physical keyboard and mouse as if plugged into the device with an OTG cable. No adb needed, mirroring is disabled. USB only; keyboard/mouse/gamepad accept only aoa or disabled.

window-title.label: Window title
window-title.description: Custom window title (default: the device model).

window-x.label: X position
window-x.description: Initial horizontal position of the window. Empty = automatic.

window-y.label: Y position
window-y.description: Initial vertical position of the window. Empty = automatic.

always-on-top.label: Always on top
always-on-top.description: Keep the window above the others.

no-window-aspect-ratio-lock.label: Free aspect ratio
no-window-aspect-ratio-lock.description: Don't lock the window aspect ratio.

render-fit.label: Render fit
render-fit.description: How the video fits the window. Default letterbox (unscaled with a flexible display).

values.letterbox: Keep the aspect ratio with black bars
values.stretched: Fill the window without keeping the aspect ratio

background-color.label: Background color
background-color.description: Window background color, in hexadecimal (#RGB or #RRGGBB).

render-driver.label: Render driver
render-driver.description: Hint to SDL about the render driver to use (it's only a hint).

no-mipmaps.label: Disable mipmaps
no-mipmaps.description: Disable mipmap generation, which improves downscaling quality with OpenGL.

no-window.label: No window
no-window.description: Don't open the scrcpy window (implies no video playback). Useful for recording or audio only.

no-playback.label: No playback
no-playback.description: Disable video and audio playback on the PC (like --no-video-playback --no-audio-playback).

disable-screensaver.label: Disable screensaver
disable-screensaver.description: Disable the PC screensaver while scrcpy is running.

turn-screen-off.label: Turn screen off
turn-screen-off.description: Turn the device screen off immediately; mirroring keeps going.

stay-awake.label: Stay awake
stay-awake.description: Keep the device awake while scrcpy is running, if the device is plugged in.

keep-active.label: Keep active
keep-active.description: Keep the screen on by simulating user activity.

screen-off-timeout.label: Screen timeout (s)
screen-off-timeout.description: Screen-off timeout during the session; the original value is restored on exit.

show-touches.label: Show touches
show-touches.description: Enable 'show touches' on start and restore it on exit. Shows physical touches only, not clicks from scrcpy.

power-off-on-close.label: Screen off on close
power-off-on-close.description: Turn the device screen off when scrcpy closes.

no-power-on.label: Don't power on at start
no-power-on.description: Don't power on the device at start.

no-cleanup.label: No cleanup on exit
no-cleanup.description: Don't remove the server from the device and don't restore its state (show touches, stay awake, power) on exit.

push-target.label: Drag & drop folder
push-target.description: Target folder on the device for files dropped on the window (passed as is to 'adb push').

record.label: Recording file
record.description: Record to a file. The format comes from --record-format or from the file extension.

record-format.label: Recording format
record-format.description: Force the recording format. opus/aac/flac/wav are audio-only and need the matching audio codec (wav = raw); mp4 supports neither raw audio nor vp8 video.

record-orientation.label: Recording orientation
record-orientation.description: Clockwise rotation of the recording, in degrees.

port.label: Local port
port.description: TCP port (or port range) the client listens on.

force-adb-forward.label: Force adb forward
force-adb-forward.description: Don't try 'adb reverse' to connect to the device.

tunnel-host.label: Tunnel host
tunnel-host.description: IP address of the adb tunnel to reach the scrcpy server. Automatically enables --force-adb-forward.

tunnel-port.label: Tunnel port
tunnel-port.description: TCP port of the adb tunnel. Automatically enables --force-adb-forward. 0 = use the tunnel's local port.

verbosity.label: Log level
verbosity.description: Level of detail of the logs.

print-fps.label: Show FPS
print-fps.description: Print the frame rate in the logs. Can be toggled at any time with MOD+i.
